title: Optimize evals 1:1 prep - regression triage 2026-03-25
content:
Meeting: 1:1 with Samir (optimize lead)
Date/time: 2026-03-25 10:00am PT
Purpose: quick triage of recent quality regressions flagged by CI + A/B results for prompt-set changes; align on next actions (rollback, canary, follow-up evals).

Agenda
- Quick recap of alerts: what triggered (metrics + sample failures)
- A/B results summary for prompt-set 'heuristics-v2' vs baseline
- Triage plan for top 3 regressions (priority, repro, rollback criteria)
- Short-term mitigations (canary, prompt pin, config changes)
- Action items & owners + deadlines

Key context / signals
- CI Evals (EV-2026) alerted on regressions in 2 model routes after deploying model v2026-03-18 + prompt-set heuristics-v2.
- Primary metric affected: top-1 correctness on extraction tasks (internal metric: ext_f1). Baseline ext_f1 = 0.912; post-change = 0.884 (drop = -0.028).
- Secondary drift seen on reranker precision@5: baseline 0.76 -> 0.72.
- A/B experiment (n ~ 12k requests over 24h) shows delta significant at p<0.01 for extraction tasks; other cohorts (chat completion) are neutral. See linked A/B sheet.

Representative failures (short samples)
- Prompt (baseline): "Extract date from text: 'Meeting scheduled for 10/11/23 at 3pm'"
  - Baseline output: "2023-10-11"
  - Heuristics-v2 output: "10/11/23" (ambiguous formatting parsed wrong in our downstream formatter)

- Prompt (Q/A): "How many active users in Q4?"
  - Baseline: "~1.2M"
  - Heuristics-v2: "1,200" (unit normalization bug introduced in post-processing layer)

Immediate hypotheses
- Heuristics-v2 added a loose normalization step that strips century in short dates -> breaks our date-parser in some locales.
- New prompt template reduces context tokens leading to lower reranker recall on long documents.
- Post-processing changes in PR#812 inadvertently changed numeric formatting (thousands vs raw numbers).

Data & artifacts to check before 1:1
- Full A/B breakdown by dataset split (prod vs synthetic) - sheets:optimize-ab-results-2026-03
- Eval dashboard EV-2026 with sample traces + latencies
- Git diff for PR#812 (linked) + infra rollout notes (release-engineering slack thread)
- Replay logs for failed cases (query ids: EV-2026-FR-1001..1010)

Proposed triage plan (short-term)
1) Hold / pin prompt-set for routes with extraction tasks -> pin to baseline prompt-set (owner: Samir) - criteria: revert heuristics-v2 until we validate normalization fixes. Target: pin within 24h.
2) Run focused evals on date/number normalization testset (3k examples) with both model+prompt configs (owner: Olivia) - due EOD 2026-03-26.
3) If numeric/date failures reproduce in focused evals, prepare hotfix to post-processing (PR w/ tests) and deploy to canary 5% traffic (owner: Lena) - tentative timeline 2026-03-27.
4) Update A/B experiment to exclude routes with low sample sizes and re-run significance tests (owner: Jamie) - due 2026-03-26.

Rollback criteria (suggested)
- If focused evals show ext_f1 drop > 0.02 vs baseline OR customer-facing error rate increases > 0.5% in canary, rollback heuristics-v2 for affected routes.

Action items (from this prep / to confirm in 1:1)
- Samir: Pin prompt-set for extraction routes and notify infra (release-engineering). Due: 2026-03-25 EOD.
- Olivia: Run targeted evals (date/number normalization) + capture samples and failure modes. Due: 2026-03-26 5pm PT.
- Lena: Prepare hotfix PR for post-processing numeric formatting + unit tests, aim for canary deploy. Due: 2026-03-27.
- Jamie: Re-run A/B analysis filtering low-volume routes and update sheets with cohort-level deltas. Due: 2026-03-26.
- Samir + Olivia: Draft customer-facing note template for postmortem if rollback affects SLAs. Due: 2026-03-28.

Open questions to bring to 1:1
- Are there any rollout-stage-specific flags we can flip (route-level) to avoid full rollback? (e.g., per-customer prompt pins)
- Do we have adequate unit tests for numeric/date normalization in the eval harness? If not, quick wins to add?
- Any scheduled sales demos / customers that might be impacted this week? (ops/stakeholder check)

Notes / talking points for Samir
- Emphasize that A/B is significant but focused on one task family - prefer targeted pinning over global rollback if possible.
- Request quick allocation from release-engineering for a same-day pin (we have precedent for emergency pins last quarter).

Follow-up plan
- Post-1:1: send sync note to #optimize with decisions + action items (Olivia)
- Update EV-2026 dashboard with post-fix runs and annotate timeline (Jamie)
- Schedule a 30min follow-up check on 2026-03-29 to validate canary results (all)

Quick links (again)
- Eval dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/evals/EV-2026-regression-dashboard
- A/B sheet: sheets:optimize-ab-results-2026-03
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/optimize/pull/812

Notes to self: keep samples short in the meeting, push for pin-first strategy, avoid over-indexing on aggregated A/B until route-level checks done.
